newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Winterthur to help finance Holocaust fund.
newsitem.headline: Winterthur to help finance Holocaust fund.

text.p: Winterthur Insurance Co is prepared to contribute to a Swiss memorial fund for Holocaust victims planned by leading businesses and the government, Winterthur President Peter Spaelti said.
"Winterthur will of course take part in a humanitarian fund within the framework of an act of solidarity by the entire Swiss business community," he told the SonntagsBlick weekly newspaper.
He said it was too early to say how big the company's contribution might be.
"Life insurers are only marginally involved in the Holocaust money problem."
Spaelti said Winterthur had found 50 dormant wartime insurance policies worth a total of 120,000 Swiss francs.

"It cannot be determined whether Jewish victims of the Nazis or of other people had these policies," he said. "We are naturally interested in actively helping find people who are entitled to these and who have not been located to date."
